home.title: Scam check
home.description: Got a message that feels wrong? Check it here before you pay, click or reply.

input.modeLabel: How do you want to check it?
input.placeholder: Paste the message here, or share it to NomadFinance from WhatsApp.
input.tooLong: This message is too long. Keep the part that asks for money, a link or your details.
input.shared: We added the message you shared. Read it, then tap Check this message.
input.privacy: Phone numbers, bank accounts and links are hidden before the message is checked. A screenshot is read once and never saved.

screenshot.dropzoneHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB

errors.badType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.generic: We could not use this image. Try another one.

progress.title: Checking the message…

progress.slow: A suspicious message can take up to a minute to explain. Please keep this page open.

result.notScamTitle: This does not look like a scam
result.readAloudFailed: We could not play the voice. Check your phone's sound and try again.
result.explainerUnavailable: We could not write the full explanation right now. Check the same message again in a moment.

type.remittance_otp_phishing: Stealing your bank login or code
type.authority_impersonation: Pretending to be an official or bank

result.confidenceLow: We are not fully sure about this one. Be careful and check it with someone you trust.
result.tacticsTitle: How it tries to trick you
result.tacticsHint: Tap a trick to see how it works.

urgency.label: Pressure to hurry
urgency.what: The sender gives a short deadline so you act before you can think or ask anyone.

authority.label: Pretending to be an official
authority.what: The sender acts like someone you must obey, such as the police, a bank, an embassy or an agency.

scarcity.label: Only a few left
scarcity.what: The sender says there is very little left, such as a few jobs or visa places, so you rush.

fear.label: Scaring you
fear.what: The sender threatens you, for example with arrest, a fine or losing your job, so you give in.

reciprocity.label: A favour to repay
reciprocity.what: The sender does you a small favour or gives a gift first, so you feel you owe them.

social_proof.label: Everyone else did it
social_proof.what: The sender says many people joined or earned money, so it looks safe.

result.messageLegend: Words that gave it away are bold and underlined.
